chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: King Oliver and Kid Ory at Economy Hall and National Park; brother Barney's early bands
summary: Where he heard Oliver and Ory play dances, and Barney's early work with Amos White and when he started.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: I was wondering, didn't one of the Duke Conchets used to play with Bob Long and Conor Mumbo?
Might have been. Was he the cornet player?

The trumpet player, yeah. Yeah, Albert. Well, he changed musicians a lot, huh? Oh, yeah, he changed musicians a lot. Did you ever hear Oliver play? Oh, yeah, King Oliver. How did he work when you heard him? Do you remember how he was playing? Where did he work at? Mm-hmm. The time I heard King Oliver, he was playing the color dance at the Economy Hall. What? Economy Hall. Then he used to play at the National Park sometimes. He'd be on third in the South Carolina. He used to have a big park there. Was that for dancing or for ball games or what kind of thing? No, it was dancing. Dancing. Regular dance was that? Regular dance at the Economy Hall, but at the parks. Sometimes they'd have dance, sometimes they'd have ball games too. But I call used to play there every Sunday. King, uh, Kid Ory. At Mudkara. Where was that? On, at the National Park. At the National Park. Yeah. Yeah, it was on third in South Cleveland. Yeah, I think Punch told us he worked there too for a while. Yeah, Punch did. Jack Carey. Jack Carey too. Where did your brother work? What bands did he work with other than the ones that you've mentioned already? Well, my brother mostly played jitter dance at Spanish Fort with Amos White. And he played with several little bands around there until he got with, uh, Anoma Twiard. Well, uh, how old was Barney when he took up his, uh, his clarinet or when he started in music? You mean when Barney left him, yeah? No, when he first, when he first, when he first, when he first, when he first... Well, Barney started in music since he was about eight years old. Eight years. Did he pick up your clarinet that your father bought? What was that? No. Old man for part to you. Wouldn't let Barney put a horn in his mouth. Nothing, he's about 15 years old. You had to learn music to sing it and all that? He's learning the music and that was it. And when he got out of the clarinet, then he taught him to clarinet. But he wouldn't let him put that, no clarinet, nothing in his mouth. He's about 15 years old. And when he left him here, Barney was 17 years old. And he's been up there since. Did he get a C melody sax or the clarinet first when he first did start to blow up? C melody sax. First, after he was playing. After he was playing around the place. And after he got him a clarinet. What happened to your old clarinet? I thought maybe Barney got that. Oh, I just stole it. Oh, yeah. I just stole it. My dad took his soul.
